newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu ends in wide range, money market short.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu ends in wide range, money market short.

text.p: Romania's leu closed Monday in a wide spread with banks' quotes ranging from 6,440/500 to 8,000/700 to the dollar against 6,600/700 to 8,000/700 in the morning.
It was not clear what the real market rate was at Monday's close when the market remained edgy.
"Everybody is chasing for leu funds so I managed to buy some greenbacks today at around 6,600," said a trader with a foreign bank in Bucharest.
The money market remained hit by strong leu shortages, which sent short-term money market prices up to 520 percent in overnight deals, he said.
Most operators said the leu was unlikely to firm further in the next few days.
"I don't think the dollar will go below 6,000 lei," said one dealer.
Some traders said they expect leu shortages to ease starting Thursday with the central bank (BNR) increasing its offer at the weekly refinancing auction.
"With more lei on offer the leu might start to inch down against the greenback," said one trader.
At the latest refinancing auction the BNR's offer of 510 billion lei was heavily oversubscribed triggering a jump of the one-week rate to 426.50 percent from 226.35.
Leu-dollar retail rates bobbed at some 7,000/8,000.
